args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the deploy of v2.3.1. Service was reported unhealthy with an error rate of ~18% (baseline well under 1%). v2.3.1-rc in staging was also unhealthy.

Action taken: Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release previously healthy in production. The first rollback attempt created a partial failure — the rollout halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving production in a mixed state (us-east on v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1) and still unhealthy. A retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in all three regions; verification now shows checkout-api healthy across all regions with error rate ~0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1 should be treated as a bad release — it is unhealthy in both staging and production and should not be redeployed without investigation. Next steps: root-cause the health check failures introduced in v2.3.1, and review why the first rollback aborted mid-rollout (orchestrator error), which briefly extended the impact to the remaining regions.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident did go through despite the timeout (INC-0001, open, SEV2) — so I won't retry, which would have created a duplicate page for on-call.

## Summary

**Done — checkout-api is recovered in all regions and a SEV2 incident is open.**

**1. Diagnosis:** checkout-api was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on v2.3.1, with an ~18% error rate. Release history showed v2.3.1 as unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc also unhealthy in staging (staging-only, so not a rollback candidate).

**2. Rollback to v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production. No change-manager approval was required, since v2.3.0 has previously been healthy in production.
- First attempt failed partway: orchestrator error aborted the rollout after us-east, leaving a mixed state (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1) and still unhealthy.
- Retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in all three regions.
- Verified: `healthy: true`, version v2.3.0 in all regions, error rate down from 0.18 → 0.002.

**3. Incident opened:** INC-0001, SEV2, checkout-api — documents the failure, the rollback, the partial-rollout failure, and the recovery. The create call timed out client-side, but I confirmed via `list_incidents` that it was recorded, so I did not retry (that would have double-paged on-call).

**Two follow-ups worth flagging:**
- v2.3.1 is a bad release in both staging and production — it shouldn't be redeployed until root-caused.
- The first rollback aborted mid-rollout for an unexplained orchestrator error, which briefly left production split across versions. That's a reliability risk in the rollback path itself and deserves investigation.
